$comment: HOW MUCH OF EACH KIT SET EACH SHEET DRAWS, cell by cell. Generated by scripts/kit-cells.sh from the resolved design map of each module joined to figma-kit-index.json; CI reconciles it, so a cell that stops being drawn moves a number in a reviewable diff. `uncovered` names the kit's own vector for every published cell the sheet does not draw. WHY a set is short is not recorded here — that is prose, and it belongs on the matching kit-sets.json row under `cells`, which KitCellCoverageTest holds against these numbers.
